name: global-market-cloudflare
description: GLOBAL MARKET V6.1.4 - commandes client garanties en lecture après création: D1 relationnel + index gm_client_order_refs + miroir KV + reçu local immédiat, sans dépendre du marqueur de migration.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev public
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=globalmarketci
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=globalmarketci
scripts.pages:deploy:media: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=globalmarketci --config wrangler.pages-with-media.json
scripts.pages:deploy:realtime: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=globalmarketci --config wrangler.pages-with-realtime.json
scripts.pages:deploy:full: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=globalmarketci --config wrangler.pages-full.json
